recipes.title: VCSL marimba line
recipes.intent: Marimba hits from the Versilian Community Sample Library (CC0, referenced, fetched on play).
recipes.code:
setcpm(100/4)
$: note("c3 e3 g3 c4 g3 e3 d3 f3").s("marimba").gain(18).room(0.2)

recipes.title: VCSL concert harp arpeggio
recipes.code:
setcpm(80/4)
$: note("c3 e3 g3 c4 e4 g4 c5 g4").s("harp").gain(2.5).room(0.3)

recipes.title: VCSL acoustic percussion set
recipes.intent: Bass drum, snare, hi-hat and timpani from VCSL (CC0, referenced).
recipes.code:
setcpm(95/4)
$: s("bassdrum1 [hihat hihat] snare_modern [hihat bassdrum1]").gain(8.5)
$: s("~ ~ ~ timpani").gain(6.8)
